question: What is the age group of the people benefitted under the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) (As of July 2022)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**18 to 50 years**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **18 to 50 years** is the age group of the people benefitted under the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) as of July 2022.
 
• PMJJBY is a government-backed life insurance scheme in India.
 
• It offers a renewable one-year term life cover of Rs. 2 lakh to all subscribing bank account holders.
